reason: Dedup engine cadence passes via the compiled claude target (turn1 full, repeat route-only, shrink re-deliver, kill-switch, fail-open) but the runtime hook surface is non-functional: hooks.json registers dist/hooks/devin/user-prompt-submit.js which the build does not produce (dist has only claude/lib/pi), and the .devin/hooks/user-prompt-submit.js shim imports ./shared.js which never existed at HEAD (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
